verdict.rationale: The UK IPO is a national government registry for filing and searching patents and trade marks. User-selectable data storage regions are a cloud or SaaS hosting capability, so this story is a category error for a jurisdiction-bound public registry. Nothing in the evidence shows the office offers any residency choice that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
